data.desc: Jiuzi Holdings, Inc. is a Chinese company primarily engaged in the new energy vehicle retail business. It operates 'Jiuzi'-branded stores, selling battery electric vehicles and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles, and is also involved in the franchising of new energy vehicle retail stores. The Company is actively expanding its technology business footprint through strategic initiatives such as its AI smart imaging and data platform, driving diversified upgrading of its business structure.
